mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointments (department_id, doctor_id, patient_id, date_time, purpose, status, bill_amount) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{patientId}, #{dateTime}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{billAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id AS departmentId, doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId, date_time AS dateTime, purpose, status, bill_amount AS billAmount FROM appointments WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, department_id AS departmentId, doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId, date_time AS dateTime, purpose, status, bill_amount AS billAmount FROM appointments

SELECT id, department_id AS departmentId, doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId, date_time AS dateTime, purpose, status, bill_amount AS billAmount FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId}

SELECT id, department_id AS departmentId, doctor_id AS doctorId, patient_id AS patientId, date_time AS dateTime, purpose, status, bill_amount AS billAmount FROM appointments WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT appt.id AS appointmentId, appt.status AS appointmentStatus, appt.bill_amount AS billAmount, h.name AS hospitalName, h.address AS hospitalAddress, d.name AS departmentName, r.number AS roomNumber, doc.full_name AS doctorName, doc.specialty AS doctorSpecialty, doc.email AS doctorEmail, p.full_name AS patientName, p.phone AS patientPhone, appt.date_time AS appointmentTime, tr.diagnosis AS diagnosis, pr.medication AS medication, ins.policy_number AS insurancePolicy, it.name AS insuranceType, adm.admitted_date AS admittedDate, adm.discharge_date AS dischargeDate, adm.status AS status FROM appointments appt JOIN departments d ON appt.department_id = d.id JOIN hospitals h ON d.hospital_id = h.id JOIN doctors doc ON appt.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN patients p ON appt.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN insurances ins ON p.insurance_id = ins.id LEFT JOIN insurance_types it ON ins.insurance_type_id = it.id LEFT JOIN treatments tr ON tr.patient_id = p.id AND tr.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions pr ON pr.treatment_id = tr.id LEFT JOIN admissions adm ON adm.patient_id = p.id WHERE appt.date_time >= #{fromDateTime} ORDER BY appt.date_time
mapper.update: UPDATE appointments SET department_id = #{departmentId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, patient_id = #{patientId}, date_time = #{dateTime}, purpose = #{purpose}, status = #{status}, bill_amount = #{billAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
